mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a rising CPIAUCSL above 237.0 signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, which raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 237.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 449,000 million dollars combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 106.0 indicates strong aggregate demand and economic momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 449000 and INDPRO > 106.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.8% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.8%, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 16,400 billion dollars over the past four quarters signals a recessionary trend, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 16400, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
